snippet.title: "Sentimental Death Loop" Trailer ENG
snippet.description:
How many times will you die by your best friend's hand?
Break free of this cycle, or be doomed to die forever!

Just as you begin to settle in for a fun day at your best friend's house, something changes in her and she kills you. And not just once—she ends your life time and time and time again.

Your goal is to escape from this endless loop of despair.


■CAST
Noa Asahi(CV:Honoka Kuroki）
Nemu Tsukishiro(CV:Yuuki Takada）
Akane Higuchi(CV:Haruka Yamazaki）
Suzuka Hayami(CV:Satsumi Matsuda）

■SPEC
Game Title:Sentimental Death Loop
Date on Sale:【Nintendo Switch】July 6, 2023　【STEAM】Summer 2023
Platform:Nintendo Switch/STEAM
Genre:A desperate time-travel adventure
Price:$19.99 
Supported Number of Players:1
Supported Languages:Japanese, English, Chinese Traditional, Chinese Simplified
VOICE:Japanese
